topApps.description: Voice Memos turns your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch into a portable audio recorder, making it easy to capture and share personal notes, song ideas, family moments, classroom lectures, and more. Editing tools like trim, replace, and the new “Save As” feature let you fine-tune your recordings without altering the original. The transcription feature converts speech into text, simplifying the process of finding and referencing specific content. And the new feature to record a vocal layer on top of an existing instrumental recording* without the need for headphones making it easy to capture song ideas on the go. Users can then separate and edit the vocal and instrumental layers independently to continue expanding on those ideas. And with iCloud support, you can capture audio on the go with your iOS device, then use your Mac to do even more with your recordings. Features Record • Record using the built-in microphone, a Bluetooth headset, or a compatible external microphone. • Choose uncompressed audio for maximum sound fidelity, ensuring the highest quality recordings. • Opt for compressed audio to save storage space and record longer sessions. • Automatically name recordings based on your location. • Record a vocal layer* over an instrumental track without headphones. • Stereo recording adds greater depth and dimension to your audio**. • iCloud support keeps your recordings and edits in sync across all your devices, including iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac, and Vision Pro. Edit • Pinch-to-zoom for more precision when editing. • Trim your recordings to save just the portion you want. • Replace and resume to fine-tune your recordings. • Save As lets you make edits and save them as a new recording without altering the original file. • Separate and independently edit the vocal and instrumental takes for layered recordings*. • Transcripts automatically convert speech into text for easy reference***. • Enhance Recording reduces background noise and room reverberation with a single tap. Organize • Quickly find recordings with the search feature. • Folders make it easy to organize your recordings. • Mark recordings as Favorites so you can quickly access them later. Listen and share • Speed up or slow down playback of your recordings, or jump 15 seconds forward or back. • Skip Silence analyzes your recordings and automatically skips over gaps in your audio. • Share multiple recordings at once via AirDrop, Mail, Messages, and more. • Import vocal layer* recordings into Logic Pro as a two-track project for advanced editing and production. * Adding a vocal layer on top of a Voice Memos recording is available only on the iPhone 16 Pro models. ** Stereo recording requires Apple devices equipped with stereo microphones and iOS 18 or later. *** Audio transcription is available on iPhone 12 and later in English (Australia), English (Canada), English (Ireland), English (New Zealand), English (South Africa), English (UK), and English (US).

No friction. Just say it, and AiReminder does the rest. Why You’ll Love AiReminder Hands-free voice input: tell the app what you want. "Call mom tomorrow morning at 9 and half" “Remind me in 5 minutes to stop the washing machine.” "Remind me to pay the gas bills on Friday, evening at 5PM” “Remind me next Monday at 9am to send the project update.” "Remind me in 2 years to renew my driver license.” "Remind me when I get home at 5pm to take the chicken out of the fridge." Instant push notification reminders Never forget anything again. AiReminder sends you timely, reliable alerts right to your device. Fast & simple workflow Open the app → Speak → You’re done. All reminders are saved and organized automatically. Automatic history View your past reminders and voice notes anytime. Perfect For: - Busy people who want quick, effortless reminders - Drivers needing hands-free note-taking - Parents managing daily routines - Students organising tasks - Anyone who prefers speaking over typing How It Works - Tap the microphone - Speak your reminder naturally - AiReminder transcribes and schedules it - Receive a push notification exactly when needed Stop typing. Start speaking. AiReminder makes your day easier, clearer, and more organised — all with your voice. Download now and experience the fastest way to set reminders.

Aida Reminder lets you create reminders very easily and quickly. Recurring reminders are fully supported, you can set hourly, daily, weekly, monthly and yearly reminders, or even reminders for specific days of the week or month. It also has a wake-up alarm with a custom snooze time. Don't miss those important events ever again! Use your own voice recordings or pick a song from your music library and set it as the reminder sound. It will play at the scheduled time. You can also create custom images with AI to make your reminders even more personal (Available on iOS 26 and later). RECURRING REMINDERS • Repeat every X hours, days, weeks, months or years (e.g. Every 4 hours, Every 2 days, Every 3 months, Every year) • Repeat on selected days of the week (e.g. Every week only on Mondays and Fridays) • Repeat on selected days of the month (e.g. Every month on the 15th, 3rd Monday of the month, Last weekday of the month) • Repeat every X hours (e.g. From 8 AM to 8 PM every 4 hours, From 9 AM to 4 PM every 2 hours and 20 mins) • Repeat every half hour (e.g. From 10 AM to 2 PM, every 30 minutes) • Repeat at specific times (e.g. 9:15 AM, 1:30 PM, 8:50 PM) MAIN FEATURES • Super fast, set up reminders in seconds • User friendly interface • 9 different categories to choose from: One-Time, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, Wake-Up Alarm, Voice Reminder, Music Reminder • Voice Reminders: Use your own voice to record reminders. They will play at the scheduled time • Music Reminders: Pick a song from your music library and set it as the reminder sound • Snooze reminders directly from the notification banner or from the lock screen • Auto-Snooze: Automatically repeat the alarm up to 5 times at regular intervals (e.g. 1 min, 10 mins, 30 mins) until you take action • Pre-Alarms: Receive up to 5 notifications before the scheduled date • Add images or photos to each reminder for easy identification, or create custom images with AI (Available on iOS 26 and later) • Option to skip the current alarm and reschedule it for the next repeating date • It has a calendar to view all reminders by month • Drop-down panel for easy access to quickly edit or reschedule any reminder • Easy one-tap action to turn individual reminders on or off • Option to pause all reminders when you don't want to be disturbed • Wake-up alarm with custom snooze time • See your past reminders in the History tab • Sort reminders by Priority or Activation Date • Backup and restore reminders on the same device or multiple devices • Auto-delete your completed reminders • More than 120 built-in images • 45 built-in alarm sounds GENERAL • Critical Alerts support • VoiceOver accessibility support • Dark Mode • Automatically adjusts to the font size selected on the device • Notifications are local. No internet connection required • App doesn't need to be open to receive notifications • Universal App, full native support for iPhone and iPad

aso_voice follow up.llmBrief: Keyword "voice follow up" searched App Store term "voice follow up" and analyzed 98 reviews from 8 apps (Voice Changer - Change Tones, Vocal Image: Speaking Coach, YoHo - Group Voice Chat, Voice Recorder ⁺ Recording, Celeb Voice Filter - Talkz) over the requested 6 month window. Use example reviews as evidence, not generic sentiment.

topApps.description: Debrief is the AI-powered meeting analysis app built for non-native English speakers working in global teams. Upload any meeting recording and get a complete breakdown of everything you might have missed. ■ Key Takeaways Summarizes the core discussion points and decisions from your meeting — clearly and concisely. ■ Vocabulary Analysis Explains unfamiliar words, business jargon, and idioms in context. Save terms to your personal word list and review them with spaced repetition (SM-2). ■ Speaking Improvements See how your sentences could be rephrased for more natural, professional English. ■ Cultural References Understand the idioms, humor, and cultural references that native speakers use — context included. ■ AI Chat Ask anything about your meeting.
